About the Fellowship

The Chicago Fellows programme supports postdoctoral research across the Biological Sciences Division. Applicants identify a faculty mentor and develop a research plan for the fellowship. The Winter 2027 cycle is advertised as open, but the closing date needs confirmation through the application guidance.

Research Areas

  • Biological sciences
  • Biomedical research
  • Postdoctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 70,000/year plus USD 10,000 annual research budget
DurationTwo years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationPhD and/or MD by the start of the fellowship; degree or clinical training recency rules apply.
Further conditionsPhD/MD required and Chicago faculty mentor; degree-recency rules apply.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusWinter 2027 cycle open; deadline to confirm
Deadline / consideration roundNot stated on checked official programme page
LocationUnited States

About University of Chicago

Chicago's Biological Sciences Division hosts the Chicago Fellows postdoctoral programme. Fellows conduct research with a faculty mentor in the division and receive support under the programme's appointment conditions.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://biologicalsciences.uchicago.edu/research/chicago-fellows

Source: biologicalsciences.uchicago.edu - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See programme page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Not stated on checked official programme page. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
